schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 72 of Male Express, The, no. 9. Three pageant performers pose onstage in gowns, including a central seated performer wearing a crown. A seated performer in a dark gown and crown poses with a standing performer wearing a white cape and broad hat. Contestant Salone poses in a floor-length ornate gown with a wide layered skirt. Contestant Kelly performs in a large feathered headdress and costume. Contestant LaRey holds a microphone in a sparkling sleeveless gown, wearing contestant number three.
